title: parasia cordata
intro: Parasia cordata, commonly known as Indian gentian, is a plant species belonging to the gentian family (Gentianaceae) that is native to the Himalayas and other parts of Asia. It has been traditionally used for its medicinal properties, which include providing relief from various health issues such as fever, cough, and digestive problems. The health benefits of Parasia cordata include its anti-inflammatory and antioxidant properties, which contribute to its therapeutic actions in reducing pain and inflammation, as well as protecting the body against oxidative stress. The bioactive constituents of Parasia cordata include iridoids, gentiopicrin, and amarogentin, which are responsible for its medicinal properties and are often used in traditional medicine to treat various ailments.
